cohort: Neonates with significant congenital heart disease admitted to a tertiary care level 4 neonatal intensive care unit with comprehensive cardiac service
finding: Despite increased gestational age and birth weight in 2010, there were no differences in length of stay, neonatal morbidity, or mortality in infants with congenital heart disease compared to 2004-2008, but there were increases in urgent cesarean deliveries and inductions.
mod_finding: In 2010, there were fewer scheduled inductions and cesarean deliveries, but more urgent inductions, cesarean deliveries after labor, and unplanned cesarean deliveries in general compared to 2004-2008.
gest_age: Mean gestational age higher in 2010 (38.4 ± 1.9 weeks) than in 2004-2008 (37.8 ± 2.3 weeks)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight higher in 2010 (3134 ± 675 g) than in 2004-2008 (2975 ± 599 g)
